notes: The catalog text covers only the Automotive Technology A.S. Degree (60.0 Credits). It has no section for the Advanced Automotive Technology Certificate of Achievement, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for the certificate.

For reference, the A.S. section has two parts. 'Automotive Technology' (Total 35) requires AT12, AT14, AT16, AT21, AT20, AT24, AT26 and AT30 at 4 units each, plus AT35 at 3 units. 'Electives' (Total 4) lists AT10 4, BUS10 3, WT53 2, WT80 2, CE42 1-2 and CET10 3. BUS10, WT53, WT80, CE42 and CET10 are not in the closed list.

The A.S. section prints six Program Learning Outcomes, two of each duplicated: 'Locate industry-standard diagnostic information to localize complex automotive problems.'; 'Successfully perform the entry-level skills and tasks required for service and repair of automotive systems.'; 'Perform common service and repair tasks identified by the National Automotive Technicians Education Foundation (NATEF).' These were not recorded because it is not clear the certificate shares them.

The description names careers for 'Programs in this field': service technician, specialty technician, and parts or service manager. The Career Information panel lists occupations such as Automotive Service Technicians and Mechanics. These were not recorded because the text does not tie them to this certificate.
A reviewer should find the certificate's own catalog page (it may be the same structure as the A.S. major, 35 + 4 units) and re-extract from it.
